messages:
maria.gomez: prod rollout for inference-worker v12 -> v13 triggered SRE pager. Error rate +420% on /v1/generate, latency P95 jumped to 2.8s, 5xxs from 0.4% to 8.1%. Alert: kube/pods/crashloop 10+ restarts across zone-us-west-2. Investigating.

sre-bot: Pager notified: @oncall-sre. Incident channel created.

jonathan: looking at pod logs -> repeated liveness fail with "readiness probe failed: context deadline exceeded" scoured init logs show attach to GPU driver delayed. Pods go CrashLoopBackOff within 15s.

maria.gomez: this started ~24s after deploy-bot reported rollout started. Deploy id: canary-deploy-2026-03-15-12:34

deploy-bot: rollout status: 23/100 updated, 12 failed -> pausing automatic progressive rollout per policy.

sam.k: hunch: livenessProbe initialDelay maybe too low for new image or scheduler change. Also HPA reacted to brief CPU spikes and scaled up, causing node pressure -> pod evictions. Need to see ReplicaSet pair.

alice.p: customers: MC-42 and app-prod region eu-west saw elevated 5xxs. Put a note into support: short blip causing 10-15s timeouts on inference calls. I'll notify customer success.

jonathan: running kubectl describe pod to gather events. Command:

``
kubectl -n prod describe pod inference-worker-abc123
kubectl -n prod logs inference-worker-abc123 --previous
``

jonathan: events show "Killed"

maria.gomez: trying quick mitigations: 1) toggle feature flag 'scheduler-v2' off (kill-switch) 2) scale down new RS to 0 replicas 3) rollback to revision 11

sam.k: I'll flip the flag now via LaunchDarkly API.

sam.k: POST /api/flags/scheduler-v2/kill -> 200 OK (:white_check_mark:)

deploy-bot: cancellation requested for rollout canary-deploy-2026-03-15-12:34. Pausing further updates.

jonathan: scaling new replicaset to 0:

``
kubectl -n prod scale rs inference-worker-v13 --replicas=0
``

jonathan: issuing rollback to replicaset v11:

``
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-worker --to-revision=11
``

sre-bot: On-call handoff: @oncall-sre -> @maria.gomez took lead at 2629001111

maria.gomez: after rollback, pods are re-creating from v11. Monitoring metrics: error-rate dropping, p95 back toward 500ms. keeping watch for node pressure.

alice.p: support updated customers with incident note and ETA: rolling back, mitigation in progress. No data exfiltration.

sam.k: noted HPA minReplicas was 1; changed to 3 to reduce rapid scale churn while images stabilize.

``
kubectl -n prod patch hpa inference-worker -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3}}'
``

jonathan: also patched deployment livenessProbe initialDelaySeconds from 5 -> 30 to avoid pre-mature kills on cold-start for v13. Applied as a temporary hotfix to the manifest in the cluster while we diagnose image startup time.

maria.gomez: applied patch, created PR to revert change after we validate. Commands:

``
kubectl -n prod set probe deployment/inference-worker --liveness --initial-delay-seconds=30 --timeout-seconds=5
``

sre-bot: incident severity set to S2 (partial degradation). Paging suppressed.

maria.gomez: current status: rollback completed, ~95% of pods on v11 healthy. Error rate back to baseline. HPA stable. We'll keep this channel open for 2 hours of post-rollback monitoring.

alice.p: filing post-incident followup checklist: root-cause hypothesis, replicate locally, determine if scheduler change in v13 needs different readiness/liveness, update canary gating (add synthetic load check), and add rollout-step pause on pod evictions.

jonathan: collecting logs and core dumps into /vault/incidents/2629001111/artifacts

sam.k: doc note: don't rely on HPA to absorb canary instability; prefer manual small canary then automated ramp once readiness passes 1m.

maria.gomez: thanks everyone. I'll schedule a blameless postmortem and tag eng-runtime and eng-ml. Closing the active mitigation. If anything new appears, re-open thread.

sre-bot: Incident closed (mitigation) at 2629004511. Postmortem owner: maria.gomez.
